{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")

# Check revenue dtype and sample values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue values: {df['revenue'].head(10).tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check if there are any new customers reached by paid_search
print(f"Rows where customer_segment == 'new' and channel == 'paid_search': {(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')}")

# Display first few rows of the filtered data
filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
filtered.head()"}
